title: Way Compass
description: This datapack adds a new form of compass that allows teleportation to a lodestone.
body:
# ✅ Features

- `/trigger rtp` teleport the user in a 8 block range, after 3 seconds (disabled by default, enabled with `/function command:rtp_enabled`).
- Add a new item : Way Compass, it can interact with a lodestone (giveable with `/function command:give/way_compass`).

⚠️ Be sure to download Way Compass resource pack ([here](https://modrinth.com/project/way-compass-rp)) ⚠️

### 🧭 Way Compass
Craft with 4 diamond, 4 popped chorus fruit and 1 compass.

## 🔜 Planned features

- When you right click with a way compass related to a lodestone, teleport at this lodestone
- Security system to prevent a teleportation in blocks and cause suffocation.

## ⚙️ Technical information

### Installation

1. Put `Way compass resourcepack` file in the `resourcepack` file of your instance (download [here](https://modrinth.com/project/way-compass-rp)).
2. When your create your world add the `way compass datapack` in the datapack list.
3. Create your world, be sure that the datapack,  resourcepack are oad, play and have fun.

### Compatibility option

Normally, this datapack and the include resourcepack was compatible with all other datapack and mods, but if you have a problems check this :
1. If the name space of other datapack/mods is `way_compass`.
2. If the datapacks/mods modify a vanilla which is modified by this datapack.
3. Else, you can report an issues on [github](https://github.com/RSN-Minecraft-Modpack/Way-Compass).
